baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal negation in `لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَا أَمَرَهُ` holds the commanded object of `يَقْضِ` short of an endpoint.
baseline_models.mechanism: The completion branch of `ق ض ي` and the directive branch of `ء م ر` form an open obligation: the censure concerns failure to bring a charge all the way to completion, not only one isolated refusal.

activation_trace.role: Completion and expiration supply the endpoint that `لَمَّا` keeps open and unrealized.
A binding directive supplies the charged content that ought to reach that endpoint.

changed_reading.after: The human's commanded undertaking remains open and unfinished; the verse diagnoses non-arrival at completion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collocation `يَقْضِ مَا أَمَرَهُ` permits the commanded content to function as something owed.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dues-settlement branch of `ق ض ي` recasts the directive as a claim upon the human. Nonperformance is therefore not an empty absence but a liability that remains unsettled.

activation_trace.role: Settling or collecting a due supplies the transactional shape of an obligation still outstanding.
The directive is the source of the claim that remains to be discharged.

changed_reading.after: The command stands as an undischarged due whose claim on the human has neither been paid nor settled.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both verbs in the focus can be heard as movement from an assigned matter to its effective realization.
baseline_models.mechanism: Perfected execution in `ق ض ي` combines with the affair branch of `ء م ر`. The test becomes whether a given matter has been carried from assignment into operative form.

activation_trace.role: Perfected making and effective execution provide the transition from assignment to realized act.
The matter or affair is the content awaiting effective realization.

changed_reading.before: The verse measures compliance with an order.
changed_reading.after: The verse also measures enactment: the human has not made the assigned affair effective in lived form.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `لَمَّا` gives the focus an explicit not-yet horizon, while both focus roots contain branches of expiration and appointment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The temporal construction activates completion or expiration in `ق ض ي` beside the appointed marker in `ء م ر`. Despite the verb form favoring command, a scheduled consummation can remain faintly audible beneath moral nonfulfillment.

activation_trace.role: Expiration or completion supplies the still-unclosed terminal boundary.
A mark or appointed time supplies the scheduled boundary toward which `not yet` points.

changed_reading.after: A marked appointment or term may also remain unclosed, allowing scheduled closure to coexist with the primary command reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pages, hands, emissaries, and truth enacted in work form a transmission relay. This activates decisive communication in `ق ض ي`: the command is not absent or inaccessible, but stalls at the final conversion of a delivered message into human action.

activation_trace.role: Decisive communication makes fulfillment the completion of a message's transit into effect.
The directive is the transmitted payload whose last human stage remains incomplete.
A written sheet gives the communication a preserved, inspectable carrier.
Hand-to-hand delivery supplies the transfer stage between record and recipient.
The envoy who removes distance supplies an active mediator in the relay.
Truth that carries speech through into work supplies the relay's successful action-state.

structural_cues: The compact sequence of honored pages, hands, emissaries, and righteous agents precedes the human censure.
The focus follows evidence of successful transmission, locating the remaining failure downstream of delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a recorded message, transfer by hands, mediators, and truth passing into work; I infer a causal relay whose final human link should enact the directive. A live alternative is that these details establish only the reminder's dignity, without defining the mechanics of fulfillment.

changed_reading.before: The human lacks an unspecified act of obedience.
changed_reading.after: The command has already crossed record, hand, and envoy; nonfulfillment is the broken last link where received communication fails to become truthful action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Growth, reminder, benefit, and purposeful movement activate the growth branch of `ء م ر` and the completion branch of `ق ض ي`. The commanded content can be read as an unfinished formative trajectory rather than a single binary act.

activation_trace.role: Growth and blessing turn the command's content into a capacity meant to increase.
Completion supplies the not-yet endpoint of the formative process.
Increase and growth supply the process that may begin in the receptive seeker.
The reminder supplies the recurring input by which growth is reactivated.
Benefit supplies the positive effect linking reminder to formation.
Purposeful movement supplies the seeker's active participation in the unfinished trajectory.

structural_cues: The opening scene repeatedly uses prospective forms: perhaps he grows, remembers, and benefits.
The seeker's movement displays process already underway without claiming that it has reached completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies increase, reminder, benefit, purposeful movement, and focus branches of growth and completion; I infer these as stages of a formative mandate held open by `لَمَّا`. A live alternative is that they are examples of obedience while the command itself remains a discrete demand.

changed_reading.before: Fulfillment is a yes-or-no response to an external order.
changed_reading.after: Fulfillment is also maturation through reminder and purposeful response; the human has not brought the commanded growth to ripeness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening scene opposes turning away and distraction to the arrival, striving, and possible benefit of a seeker, while self-sufficiency attracts attention. This makes command execution relational: delivery is unfinished when attention is routed by status instead of receptivity.

activation_trace.role: Effective execution requires the directive to become an actual relation of address and response.
The directive supplies the norm against which the routing of attention is measured.
Turning away supplies the failed orientation that interrupts reception.
Actual arrival places a receptive person within reach of the message.
Possible benefit supplies the consequence blocked or enabled by attention.
Claimed self-sufficiency supplies the socially attractive but unreceptive pole.
Purposeful approach supplies the receptive pole toward which delivery should be oriented.
Being occupied by one thing away from another supplies the attentional diversion that leaves the charge incomplete.

structural_cues: The paired `as for` constructions contrast the self-sufficient person with the one who arrives striving.
Motion and orientation reverse across the scene: one party approaches while the addressed party turns or is distracted away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed movements, unequal attention, and a potentially beneficial message; I infer that correct relational routing is one mode of executing the focus command. A live alternative is that the opening correction concerns a distinct addressee and should not specify the later human's unfinished charge.

changed_reading.before: Command fulfillment is private compliance by an isolated individual.
changed_reading.after: A command can remain unexecuted through misdirected attention: the message fails when status outranks the receptive person who comes seeking it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A completed divine sequence of creating, apportioning, opening a path, easing it, causing death, and reviving stands immediately before the human's `not yet`. The execution branch of `ق ض ي` turns the focus into an asymmetry between what has been fully done to and for the human and what the human has not carried through.

activation_trace.role: Perfected making and execution supply the shared metric for the completed divine side and incomplete human side.
The directive identifies the human side of the reciprocal commission.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the first completed divine operation.
Measured planning and governance supply ordered design rather than accidental existence.
An extended traversable path supplies the route on which the human commission can operate.
Opening and ease after difficulty remove inability as the sole explanation for incompletion.
Causing life's power to depart supplies a completed terminal operation under divine agency.
Reviving the dead completes the displayed itinerary and sharpens the contrast with human noncompletion.

structural_cues: The repeated completed and causative verbs keep divine agency stable through the life itinerary.
`كَلَّا لَمَّا` then interrupts that completed sequence with a human-side not-yet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a serial set of completed divine operations, an enabled path, and the focus's execution branch; I infer a reciprocal contrast in which received formation calls for human enactment. A live alternative is that the life sequence proves power and dependence without establishing a reciprocal commission.

changed_reading.before: The human fails a command considered in isolation.
changed_reading.after: The human's unfinished commission is exposed against a fully executed divine itinerary of making, enabling, ending, and reviving him.

context_deltas.mechanism: Death, will-dependent revival, the arrival of the overwhelming break, and the named day thicken the temporal force of `لَمَّا`. Together they strengthen the faint baseline in which `ق ض ي` closes an enacted end and `ء م ر` carries an appointed marker.

activation_trace.role: An enacted end through death supplies a terminal sense that can remain pending in `not yet`.
The appointed marker supplies a scheduled horizon alongside the primary directive sense.
Loss of life and power supplies the first explicit closure in the itinerary.
Will attached to an event supplies the condition governing when closure is reversed.
Revival after death extends the itinerary beyond its apparent first endpoint.
Arrival supplies the event's transition from pending schedule to realized occurrence.
A delimited span of time supplies the named horizon at which the deferred itinerary becomes public.

structural_cues: `ثُمَّ إِذَا شَاءَ` and the later `فَإِذَا جَاءَتِ` create two will-and-arrival thresholds around the focus.
The branchless `ص خ خ` occurrence at 80:33 is used only as the structural rupture introducing the named day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies death, contingent revival, event-arrival, a temporal day, and focus branches of enacted end and appointment; I infer one deferred life-course closure. The materially live alternative is the stronger grammatical reading that `أَمَرَهُ` denotes only a moral directive, with eschatological timing serving as surrounding consequence.

changed_reading.before: The not-yet refers only to unfinished conduct.
changed_reading.after: The not-yet can also suspend the human itinerary before an appointed closure that passes through death, revival, and the arriving day.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first verse after the focus commands the human to look, then unfolds food into poured water, opened earth, growth, and benefit. This supplies a concrete candidate for `what He commanded him`: sustained attention that traces ordinary provision back through its hidden production chain and reverses the covering of blessing.

activation_trace.role: Effective execution makes looking a task that must be carried through the whole causal sequence.
The directive branch receives a nearby explicit imperative as a possible specification of its content.
Growth and blessing connect the commanded inspection to the productive process being inspected.
Covering a blessing supplies the epistemic failure that careful looking must reverse.
Directed sight or insight supplies the explicit human action immediately following the unfinished command.
Livelihood supplies the familiar endpoint whose concealed dependencies are to be followed backward.
Deliberate pouring supplies the first causal operation behind the visible food.
Opening the earth supplies the hidden rupture through which production proceeds.
Cultivation and caused growth supply the conversion of prior operations into nourishment.
Enjoyed benefit identifies the recipient-facing output of the chain.

structural_cues: The immediate post-focus imperative `فَلْيَنظُرِ` repeats the human subject and points to a specific object.
The following first-person plural verbs unpack one consumed object into a serial causal process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate imperative to inspect food, a prior covering of blessing, and a causal production sequence; I infer that this imperative concretizes at least one dimension of `مَا أَمَرَهُ`. A live alternative is that the food sequence only supplies evidence after a wholly general censure.

changed_reading.before: The content of the unfinished command remains wholly unspecified.
changed_reading.after: One live content is commanded causal attention: look through consumed provision to the operations that produced it instead of covering the blessing at its visible endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Livelihood, caused growth, benefit, and good condition activate both the blessing branch of `ء م ر` and the dues branch of `ق ض ي`. Provision becomes an advance that generates an owed response; covering the gift leaves that account open.

activation_trace.role: Settlement of a due makes the human response resemble an outstanding account.
Growth and blessing supply what has been advanced to the human before repayment.
Covering a blessing supplies the failure to acknowledge what created the due.
Livelihood supplies the recurring material receipt on the human side of the account.
Caused cultivation identifies growth as given output rather than autonomous possession.
Useful provision for needs supplies the concrete value received.
Good condition and blessing widen provision beyond food to the beneficiary's sustained state.

structural_cues: The production catalog closes with the explicit beneficiary phrase `for you and for your livestock`.
The censure of covering blessing precedes the catalog, while settlement language sits at the focus between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated benefits, an identified beneficiary, covering of blessing, and focus branches of blessing and dues; I supply the arrow that receipt creates an owed response. A live alternative is that provision demonstrates power and generosity without operating as a debt relation.

changed_reading.before: The due arises only because an authority issued words.
changed_reading.after: The due is also generated materially by what sustains the human; each received benefit deepens the still-unsettled response owed to its giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flight from kin strips away social transfer, then every person is enclosed by an affair sufficient to occupy him. The affair branch of `ء م ر` and settlement branch of `ق ض ي` turn the focus into a personal docket that no intimate can absorb or complete for another.

activation_trace.role: Matter or affair supplies the personal case carried toward the later day.
Settlement supplies the unresolved disposition required for each personal case.
Flight supplies the collapse of kinship as a means of sharing or transferring the case.
The individual person supplies the irreducible bearer of the unfinished matter.
Encompassing totality distributes the condition without exception to every person.
An affair or grave concern echoes the focus matter as a personally occupying docket.
Sufficiency supplies the case's capacity to occupy its bearer fully, excluding reliance on kin.

structural_cues: The sequence enumerates brother, mother, father, spouse, and children before assigning an affair to every person.
The singular personal bearer survives while the normal network of mutual support disperses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies kin-flight, exhaustive individuation, and a personally sufficient affair; I infer that the focus's unsettled matter becomes a nontransferable docket. A live alternative is that the later affair denotes immediate terror rather than the same obligation left open in the focus.

changed_reading.before: Humanity in general has not fulfilled a command.
changed_reading.after: Each person carries an unfinished matter as a nondelegable case; kinship cannot settle, share, or conceal it on the arriving day.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final contrast renders outcomes on faces through disclosure, integrated outward and inward completion, residue, and overpowering cover. Activated by the sign branch of `ء م ر`, completed or failed execution in `ق ض ي` becomes something that eventually leaves a publicly readable surface trace.

activation_trace.role: Effective execution supplies the hidden process whose result later becomes visible.
A mark or sign supplies the diagnostic form in which execution can finally appear.
The lighting up of face or light supplies disclosed positive outcome.
The face as forward surface supplies the public display plane.
Completion joining outward and inward states supplies congruence rather than a cosmetic expression.
A remainder left after what has passed supplies persistent residue of the unresolved process.
Overpowering cover supplies the negative trace that takes possession of the visible surface.

structural_cues: Two groups are distinguished not by narrated dossiers but by opposed face states.
The movement from present noncompletion to later visible contrast allows hidden execution to acquire an eventual surface.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uncovered brightness, outward-inward congruence, persistent residue, and overpowering cover; I infer that these surfaces manifest how the focus commission was carried. A live alternative is that the faces display judgment's consequences without encoding the command's execution itself.

changed_reading.before: Fulfillment or failure remains an invisible private relation to a command.
changed_reading.after: What remains unfinished now eventually resolves into a visible diagnostic trace, with inner execution or neglect rendered on the public face.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant waterskin-decay branch of `ق ض ي` inside a verbal command construction. It remains anchored in the focus root and gains a material bridge from the packet's drop, watering, and human-growth images. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory analogy in which delay degrades capacity, never as a replacement lexical gloss for `يَقْضِ`.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The not-yet delay modifies `يَقْضِ`, whose inventory includes deterioration caused by leaving a vessel unused too long.

activation_trace.role: A waterskin decaying through prolonged neglect supplies deterioration caused by delay itself.
Growth and blessing supply the productive capacity that neglect leaves unused.
Water ranging from a drop to generative fluid supplies the human vessel's material beginning.
Conveyed water through pouring supplies the maintenance input a vessel must receive and transmit.
Human growth and upbringing supply the capacity that should develop rather than spoil unused.

changed_reading.before: Delay merely leaves the command undone.
changed_reading.after: Delay can itself damage the provisioned human capacity, so nonfulfillment accumulates as deterioration through neglect.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading treats the command as seed-like potential, which is surprising because neither focus word literally names a seed. It remains anchored in the focus branches of growth and execution and is activated by packet-backed covering, earth-opening, grain, germination, and bursting. Downstream prose should mark it as a material model of latent activation, not as a claim that `أَمَرَهُ` denotes seed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The growth branch of `ء م ر` and execution branch of `ق ض ي` allow commanded potential to be tested by whether it emerges into realized form.

activation_trace.role: Growth and blessing supply the command's latent productive potential.
Effective execution supplies emergence of latent potential into accomplished form.
Covering seed supplies the ambiguous condition that can either prepare growth or become suppressive concealment.
The earth's opening supplies the rupture required for latent content to emerge.
A plant exiting the earth supplies visible realization of previously hidden potential.
The grain that both grows and bears grain supplies a recursively productive outcome.
Wide splitting and bursting supply a distant negative mirror of emergence that breaks bounds rather than fulfilling form.

changed_reading.before: The command is external speech awaiting compliance.
changed_reading.after: The command can be modeled as latent seed-like capacity whose required execution is emergence into fruitful form; covering without cultivation leaves it unrealized.

strongest_changes: The completed divine life itinerary makes the focus a sharp execution asymmetry: the human has received making and an eased path but has not carried his side through.
The immediate imperative to inspect food gives the otherwise open `what He commanded him` a concrete attentional candidate tied to a hidden production chain.
Provision activates settlement language, allowing benefit to create an outstanding response rather than serving only as background evidence.
The later flight from kin and each person's sufficient affair turn the unfinished matter into a nontransferable personal docket.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's two roots support completion, execution, communication, settlement, affair, growth, and appointment. Ordered context does not collapse these into one gloss: it successively turns the same not-yet into a broken message relay, arrested maturation, failed relational attention, asymmetric execution, deferred closure, unperformed inspection, unpaid provision, a personal case, and a visible trace.
remaining_uncertainties: The directive syntax of `أَمَرَهُ` remains stronger than the appointment and growth branches, so those readings should coexist without displacing command.
The immediate food imperative may instantiate part of `مَا أَمَرَهُ`, or it may only exemplify a more general obligation.
The debt model depends on the reader-supplied arrow from received benefit to owed response.
The opening attentional correction may illuminate the later human censure structurally without sharing the same immediate subject.
